text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During an interview, Ines Fujin confidently reaffirms her goal of winning the Japanese Derby as the most popular Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've worked towards this dream together, and the deep trust we share has left her with an unwavering resolve. That much is clear from the look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan has also been spurred onward by Ines Fujin's efforts. She explains that watching Ines helped her to bring her own dream into focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Ines Fujin has a dream of her own, and it's one she means to realize. After all, her sisters have come to the Japanese Derby to cheer her on!
